summary: Operator pages (rates page modified 2025-10-28): $56 a night, $45 with a 20% discount for Good Sam/FMCA/AARP/Escapees/seniors/military; weekly $225, monthly $480; open all year (showers closed late Oct-Apr); 76 FHU 30/50A sites, 35 pull-thrus; phone booking, pay on arrival. Price gate: over $50 at list, no gateway within 40 km, not a Good Sam Park - drop candidate unless the posted 20% membership/senior discount counts.
flags: PRICE GATE (private) - DROP CANDIDATE for AWH: posted rate (operator page last modified 2025-10-28) is $56 a night for 2 people, the only RV site type, so $56 is the cheapest night in every season (no seasonal rates). gateways.py 36.8092,-90.4676 -> none within 40 km (nearest Memphis 188 km). Good Sam directory: not a Good Sam Park (stored good_sam false, derived). BUT the operator posts a 20% discount to $45 for Good Sam, FMCA, AARP, Escapees, seniors, military, veterans and emergency responders. The GS-Park exception is for the 10% Good Sam Park discount; whether an operator's own 20% membership/senior discount (any Good Sam member pays $45) lifts the gate is AWH's call.

DISCOUNTS: good_sam written true from the operator's own statement (20% for Good Sam members), replacing the directory-derived false; military true confirmed. The directory still says it is not a Good Sam Park - the note says so.
PRESENCE: operator site (current: home page advertises a workcamper position for Spring 2027; rates page modified 2025-10-28) + Google 4.3 stars, 358 reviews. Phone booking only, no engine.

LONG-STAY (weekly $225 and monthly $480 marketed, so the five tests were run): (1) nightly price posted - pass; (2) no booking engine but a posted nightly price and phone reservations - pass; (3) marketing leads with transients ('MAKE US A CONVENIENT OVERNIGHT STOP', 'centrally located between Branson MO and Nashville') - pass; (4) one-night occupancy check NOT POSSIBLE - no booking engine; Esri imagery (winter, leaf-off) shows roughly 30 rigs on 76 sites with most of the 35 pull-thrus on the central loop empty, and a mobile-home row west of the park drive is a separate property, so there is room for nightly guests but the nightly share is unmeasured; (5) the one dated review on the site (Apr 2025) is from a guest 'new to Missouri' - inconclusive. Not a long-stay drop on this evidence; the cheap $480 monthly rate means test 4 is the one to watch.
Pin OK: stored 36.8092,-90.4676 is the entrance on US-67 (the operator's own GPS 36.80922,-90.46743); the loops run 100-400 m NE of it, centre near 36.8100,-90.4665 (~130 m). Under the threshold.
Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed: no water on imagery; the operator gives Black River 3-9 miles and a lake 18 miles.
